crossRefs.note: He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
For your loving kindness is great toward me. You have delivered my soul from the lowest Sheol.
For a fire is kindled in my anger, that burns to the lowest Sheol, devours the earth with its increase, and sets the…
For the enemy pursues my soul. He has struck my life down to the ground. He has made me live in dark places, as those…
The way of the wicked is like darkness. They don’t know what they stumble over.
He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
Angels who didn’t keep their first domain, but deserted their own dwelling place, he has kept in everlasting bonds…
wild waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, for whom the blackness of darkness has been…
Don’t let the flood waters overwhelm me, neither let the deep swallow me up. Don’t let the pit shut its mouth on me.
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.

translations.web: You have laid me in the lowest pit, in the darkest depths.
translations.bsb: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
translations.kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.
translations.asv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, In dark places, in the deeps.
